verdict.rationale: Several independent users report kitty has excellent ligature support (e.g. with FiraCode) and choose it over Alacritty and iTerm Metal for that reason. The docs include a dedicated "Changing kitty fonts" page and kitty.conf reference, and one user reports kitty renders a difficult Unicode test file correctly, which implies capable glyph fallback. Bitmap fonts are not supported. missing for 10: explicit documentation content on fallback-font configuration (e.g. symbol mapping), evidence of fine-grained font tuning options, bitmap font support.
